title: wARS records its first mint on World Chain
description: Ripio's wFIAT timeline records the first-ever mint of wARS on World Chain on 2025-05-21. SOG treats this as a dated network-deployment milestone and does not infer that it was the asset's original global launch.
notes: World Chain expansion milestone only; original global wARS launch date remains unresolved.

title: wCOP goes live on Arc with Ripio's wFIAT suite
description: Ripio announced that all six wFIAT local stablecoins, including wCOP, were live on Arc public mainnet from day one with on-chain liquidity support.
notes: Arc deployment/adoption event only. It does not establish the original wCOP launch date or change reserve/redemption status.
